notes: GM board v1, box-score only. Tiers and archetypes are threshold rules in gm_board.py, never reputation. RPR here is RPR v1.2 (Nov 20, 2026): ORtg shrunk toward the league average (K = 200 possessions used) and opponent-adjusted, with the counting terms centered on the league-average per-36 rates, so an average player scores about 0. The tier thresholds were recalibrated for v1.2's centered scale (see gm_board.py tier()): Franchise RPR >= 3.5, All-Star >= 2.5, High-value starter >= 1.5. Players with GP < 8 or under 150 total minutes are labelled Insufficient minutes and are not tiered; the Overvalued guard fires only after that gate. Age, height (inches) and weight (lbs) come from the ESPN roster pull. No contracts or salaries: contracts are not free anywhere. No tracking or on/off data.
